annotation_method: manual semantic review of each before/after SVG pair

cases.reference_summary: The rectangle keeps the same red appearance; only the authored fill spelling changes.

main_visual_changes.description: The rectangle's fill spelling changes from red to #ff0000 without changing its resolved color or visible appearance.

relative_importance.rationale: The authored representation changes, but the intended and rendered color are equivalent.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The fill is rewritten from a named red to the equivalent hexadecimal red.
There is a source-level color notation change with no visual color change.

cases.reference_summary: The red rectangle moves left by 0.00001 user units.

main_visual_changes.description: The rectangle's x position changes from 1.0 to 0.99999, a 0.00001-unit leftward shift.

relative_importance.rationale: The geometry change is real and continuous but extremely small relative to the viewport.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The red rectangle shifts imperceptibly to the left.
A tiny negative x-position delta moves the rectangle left by approximately 0.00001 units.

cases.reference_summary: The large central panel changes from red to blue.

main_visual_changes.description: The large central rectangle changes its fill from red to blue across most of the viewport.

relative_importance.rationale: A strong color change affects a large contiguous foreground area.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The main panel switches color from red to blue.
Most of the canvas-sized central block is recolored blue instead of red.

cases.reference_summary: A green square is inserted in the center of the white canvas.

main_visual_changes.description: A new 6 by 6 green rectangle appears at the center of the existing white background.

relative_importance.rationale: The insertion creates a distinct new foreground object over a moderate part of the viewport.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: A centered green square is added to the white background.
The after image introduces a small green block in the middle.

cases.reference_summary: The referenced gradient changes from a red-to-blue ramp to a green-to-blue ramp.

main_visual_changes.description: The large rectangle's gradient starts green instead of red while retaining the blue end stop.

relative_importance.rationale: A shared paint-resource edit recolors a large portion of the central rectangle.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The gradient's first stop changes from red to green, affecting the filled box.
The panel changes from a red-blue gradient to a green-blue gradient.

cases.reference_summary: A fully transparent rectangle is inserted without changing the visible rendering.

main_visual_changes.description: An 8 by 8 red rectangle is added, but opacity zero gives it no painted or visible contribution.

relative_importance.rationale: The document structure and geometric footprint change, but final pixels do not.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: A hidden transparent rectangle is inserted with no visual effect.
The SVG gains an opacity-zero red box, so the rendered appearance remains unchanged.

cases.reference_summary: The black diagonal reverses direction across the square canvas.

main_visual_changes.description: The black diagonal changes from the top-left to bottom-right direction into the bottom-left to top-right direction.

relative_importance.rationale: The line remains similar in extent and weight but occupies the opposite diagonal.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The diagonal black stroke flips from a backslash orientation to a slash orientation.
The path changes from a descending diagonal to an ascending diagonal across the canvas.

cases.reference_summary: The red square moves four pixels to the right because its parent group translation changes.

main_visual_changes.description: The red rectangle moves four CSS pixels to the right when the parent group's translation changes from 1 to 5.

relative_importance.rationale: The same opaque object moves across a visible portion of the small viewport.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The parent group shifts the red square four pixels right.
The rectangle's cumulative transform changes from a one-pixel to a five-pixel horizontal translation.

cases.reference_summary: The embedded image changes from solid red to solid blue while keeping the same placement.

main_visual_changes.description: The 12 by 12 embedded raster changes from red to blue without moving or resizing.

relative_importance.rationale: Every intrinsic pixel and the full placed image area changes between two strongly contrasting colors.

acceptable_alternative_descriptions: The embedded image is recolored from red to blue.
The central raster keeps its bounds but all decoded pixels change color.
